item.title: Select the Right Coffee Variety
item.description: Selecting the right coffee variety is a crucial step in cultivating coffee plants, as different coffee species and varieties have distinct flavor profiles, growing requirements, and resistance to pests and diseases. The two main species of coffee that are cultivated for coffee beans are Arabica (Coffea arabica) and Robusta (Coffea canephora).
